review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity/base commit, and exact writable binding scopes agree with the original PRD. The implementation owners and bounded runtime/type regression files are supported by the supplied source and configuration evidence. The implementation/independent-verification split, verification dependency, and required AC coverage are explicit. The allowed implementer and verifier have matching roles, availability, and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant contract, shared-data, state, asynchronous-consumer, TypeScript, failure-handling, and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Eligibility need not rely on persona or pending legacy claims. A separate active project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD normalization. Model, sampling, budgets, prompt, team, repository, decision-input, and metric-policy fingerprints are frozen. Historical old-version operations retained on the reused project do not constitute candidates on this bundle under the supplied isolation facts. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation.
